template.title: Blueprint Publishing Workflow
template.description: Governance workflow for publishing blueprints to the system register with semantic versioning, review, and signed publication.

instructions.overview:
## Blueprint Publishing

This workflow governs the publication of blueprints to the Sorcha system register.

### Version Types
- **Major version** (structural): Changes to actions, routes, schemas, or participants
- **Minor version** (documentation): Changes to instructions, help text, or translations only

### Process
1. Author submits a blueprint draft
2. System classifies the change type (structural vs documentation)
3. Reviewer examines and approves or rejects
4. Publisher signs and commits to the system register

actionInstructions.0: Submit the blueprint you wish to publish. Include the full blueprint JSON and any change notes.
actionInstructions.1: The system will compare the blueprint against the latest published version to determine if this is a structural or documentation-only change.
actionInstructions.2: Perform a full review of the blueprint including structure, schema compatibility, and compliance. Approve or reject with comments.
actionInstructions.3: Perform a documentation review. Verify instruction text, translations, and help content are accurate and complete.
actionInstructions.4: Sign and publish the approved blueprint to the system register. This creates an immutable, signed transaction.

participantInstructions.Author: You are submitting a blueprint for publication. Ensure all structural elements and instructions are complete before submission.
participantInstructions.Reviewer: You are responsible for validating the blueprint meets quality and compliance standards. Full review for structural changes; documentation review for text-only changes.
participantInstructions.Publisher: You are the final sign-off authority. Your signature commits the blueprint to the system register as an immutable transaction.

participants.name: Author
participants.instructions: Submit blueprint drafts for publication. You can revise and resubmit if rejected.

participants.name: Reviewer
participants.instructions: Review submitted blueprints for quality and compliance. Approve or reject with comments.

participants.name: Publisher
participants.instructions: Sign and publish approved blueprints to the system register.

actions.title: Submit Draft
actions.description: Author submits a blueprint for publication review
actions.instructions: Submit the complete blueprint JSON along with change notes describing what was modified.

blueprintJson.description: The full blueprint JSON to be published

changeNotes.description: Description of changes from the previous version

actions.title: Classify Change
actions.description: System compares structural hash to classify change type
actions.instructions: The system will automatically compare the structural hash of your submission against the latest published version.

changeType.description: Whether the change affects structure or only documentation

proposedVersion.description: The proposed semantic version (e.g., v2.0 or v1.3)

structuralHash.description: SHA-256 hash of the blueprint with instructions stripped

actions.title: Full Review
actions.description: Reviewer performs comprehensive review of structural changes
actions.instructions: Review the complete blueprint for structural integrity, schema compatibility, participant definitions, and routing correctness.

approved.description: Whether the blueprint is approved for publication

reviewerAddress.description: Reviewer's wallet address for audit trail

routes.description: Rejected → return to author for revision

actions.title: Documentation Review
actions.description: Reviewer performs lightweight review of documentation-only changes
actions.instructions: Review the instruction text, translations, and help content for accuracy and completeness. No structural review needed.

approved.description: Whether the documentation changes are approved

actions.title: Sign & Publish
actions.description: Publisher signs and commits the blueprint to the system register
actions.instructions: Sign the approved blueprint with your wallet key. This creates an immutable, signed transaction on the system register.
